source.identity_note: This packet is bound to the exact implementation commit. The packet files themselves are added by the following evidence-only commit.

scope.checkpoint: E3 / M2 Critical Moment Map LangGraph conformance
behavior_change: Run M2 generation through one startup-compiled LangGraph subgraph using the shared SQLite checkpointer.
Keep canonical assets and private source text out of graph checkpoints and sanitized traces.
Use idempotent node effects, explicit terminals, stale-input safe-stop and restart without duplicate canonical writes.
Require an explicit trusted user decision for every agent-proposed critical moment before map confirmation.
Represent user-confirmed and unresolved criticality separately and attach trusted confirmation timestamps only to user-confirmed entries.
Reopen M2 and withdraw a prior criticality confirmation when the corresponding title changes.
Preserve deterministic M1 dependency invalidation and source-linked known, missing and conflicting time states.
Keep an invalidated M2 visible, require explicit regeneration, and bind the replacement map to the newly accepted M1 version.
non_goals: No E4/M3 implementation, cross-asset RAG, route generation, export or performance optimization.
No remote model API and no new W7900, ROCm, vLLM or performance claim.

l1_milestones: M2 Timeline and Critical Moment Map
quality_mapping.track_2_relevance: Demonstrates private local multi-step Agent orchestration, durable recovery and a human-controlled decision boundary for an auditable Critical Moment Map.
quality_mapping.submission_impact: Provides a reproducible E3 product and Agent proof. W7900 serving evidence remains a separate delegated verification and this packet makes no performance claim.

hardware.gpu_note: W7900 verification is outside this E3 local candidate and is delegated to kinnyuww.

commands.cmd: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q && .venv/bin/python -m ruff check app tests scripts
bash -n scripts/*.sh && python3 -m py_compile scripts/*.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s qa/tests -v && bash qa/gates/pr_gate.sh --mode contract
commands.result: 32/32 public QA tests and the repository contract gate passed.

commands.cmd: npm test -- --run && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run verify:contracts
commands.result: 108/108 Vitest tests, typecheck, ESLint, build and 15/15 contract provenance checks passed with no lint warnings.
Generated OpenAPI/JSON Schema files are current and the diff has no whitespace errors.

commands.cmd: loopback FastAPI plus Vite preview, driven with browser automation, DOM snapshots, trusted selections and full-page screenshots
commands.result: The real browser journey generated and edited M2, blocked confirmation before trusted decisions, survived reload, reopened after a confirmed title edit, invalidated after a depended M1 correction, and explicitly regenerated against the newly accepted M1 version.

failures.impact: The standard wrapper could not download its package because of local npm TLS configuration; no application request failed.
failures.recovery: Used the already cached Playwright CLI package offline and completed the same CLI-first browser flow.

observations: The browser console recorded an expected pre-creation M2 404 and a missing favicon 404; subsequent M2 create, edit and confirm requests returned success.
The local LangGraph dependency emits a pending deprecation warning about a future serializer default; current tests and behavior pass.
unverified: Independent quality-owner acceptance and E3 promotion.
New W7900/ROCm/vLLM performance evidence; existing accepted local-serving evidence is unchanged.
